title: Unit Event — Choices for the Future — Episode4 Afraid to Step Forward

meta.Event Outline: Emu continues studying management with the Morinomiya Revue. While leading fulfilling days full of new connections, she learns that a threat is coming to bear on Morinomiya's Kikyogumi troupe.

rows.Line: A few days later
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (How do we save Kikyogumi from being disbanded...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (They're making that announcement in three weeks, so we gotta come up with something before then.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Let's see... What if we got robots like Robo-Nene to replace any troupe members that left?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I mean, she can do all sorts of things like jumping really high and moving super fast.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But that doesn't really fit what Morinomiya's going for...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(I've been thinking really hard since then...
But I haven't been able to come up with any good ideas...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nooo!
Why can't I just easy-peasy-lemon-squeezy ideas out of my brain?!
E-Easy-peasy-lemon-squeezy...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was worried that you weren't feeling well when I saw you curled up on a bench like this...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But that doesn't appear to be the case.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, umm...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is something bothering you...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'll be more than happy to listen.
But you don't have to tell me if you don't feel comfortable, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks, KAITO.
The thing is...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see...
And you're trying to come up with a way to save Kikyogumi now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
At first, I thought we could try to get the Suzurangumi fans to start liking them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My hope was that they'd start liking Kikyogumi since they already like going to see shows.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Both troupes have to share the same theatre.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And because of that, Suzurangumi hasn't been able to put on as many performances.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which has made a lot of their fans really sad and disappointed.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If that's the case, then some Suzurangumi fans might hold a very negative opinion of Kikyogumi.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There are a lot of other things that I have to keep in mind too...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I'm starting to wonder if I'm ever going to come up with an idea that's going to make everyone smile.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I really don't want Kikyogumi to get disbanded!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because the show we saw them put on was so amazing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Even after they closed the curtains, my heart was still racing. I didn't want it to end...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's why I believe Kikyogumi can make lots and lots more people smile.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Saving them isn't going to be easy, but I'm still gonna do my best.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It sounds like you know what you want to do, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Yup!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I felt like I was running in circles, but my head feels a lot clearer after talking to you, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: All I can really do is listen to your concerns, Emu, but I'll be rooting for you...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks, KAITO!
The next day
Morinomiya Music Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
This is incredible...
You really came up with all these ideas in that short period?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup...!
I wrote down everything that popped into my head!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You probably came up with some of the same ideas already, but do you see any that might be worth giving a try...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Each one is fun and creative, but I'm not sure we have the time or budget to make them happen...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I know you worked hard to come up with these.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, that's okay!
I'd rather you tell me straight out that they aren't possible!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Still, this is so hard...
If we don't hurry, then Kikyogumi is really gonna be disbanded...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I know. After they announce what's happening, it's going to be next to impossible to get them to take it back.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: And I'm also having trouble coming up with the perfect solution. But I am certain that getting young people to start supporting the troupe is going to play a key role...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, wait...! Ms. Suzu, I have a question!
They're really popular with young people, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Would it be possible to lower ticket prices somehow?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right now, you have to pay the same price as a Suzurangumi show... But if you want more young people to come, then lower might be the way to go.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That should make it easier for people to invite their friends to come along!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I've already come up with a similar idea, and even suggested it to the board. They rejected it outright...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Without some way to bring new or existing fans in droves, lowering ticket prices would simply result in a drop in revenue.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: That would mean a smaller budget for each show...resulting in lower quality performances. Morinomiya is firmly against that.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Because they want to provide the audience with the best experience imaginable. Morinomiya has existed for a hundred years precisely because it's been doing just that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I think I'm starting to get a better idea of what the people running Morinomiya care about the most.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You can still put on amazing performances without money, right...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The Wonder Stage used to get almost no funding. We had to make things ourselves for a while...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We even repaired all the old seats that were there ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What if we all worked together and came up with ways for the audience to have fun?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wouldn't that make it possible to give them the best experience imaginable, while also lowering ticket prices...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: In theory, that may be possible.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then...!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
But that's only in theory.
We have no idea what's going to happen if we put your idea into practice...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I know... But...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But if there is a possibility, then we should try to think it through.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If you lock down all the little details and make the suggestion based on that, maybe it'll go better this time!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I know. I've been telling myself the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: But... The truth is...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I'm really scared.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Morinomiya needs to change if it's going to exist in the future.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: In that sense, I don't regret pushing for the formation of Kikyogumi.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: That decision ended up disappointing some of our existing fans.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You mean how when it was decided that two troupes would be sharing the theatre, it came as a huge disappointment to the Suzurangumi fans?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yes. I honestly wasn't expecting that to happen.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I should've seen that coming...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
I know this is foolish of me...
No change is going to have a 100% approval rating.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: But the thought of ending up saddening even more people...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
I can't get that out of my head...
I think I'm frozen with fear at this point.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I know what she means...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Trying to get Morinomiya to move forward might mean disappointing even more fans...)
